text:
Maria: Quick heads-up — AltaHealth QBR next Tue. Usage spike last Thurs, looks embedding-heavy. Need a short cost mitigation plan and a list of HTAs (high-touch asks) for the meeting.
TJ: Saw the spike in the billing alerts. 3.2x tokens/day for embeddings, mostly bulk index jobs running nightly. Alert triggered at 80% credits.
Sarah: They are on a small retainer with overage protection but want guidance before renewal. Risk: if costs keep up they may push back on renewals.
Leo: I can run an enablement session focused on batching and prefix-caching. Quick question — are they using /embed endpoint with 2048-dim model?
TJ: Yes, 2048-dim embeddings via open-embed-2048. Lots of duplicate calls to reindex unchanged docs.
Maria: Actionable asks for QBR: 1) short-term guards (alerts, caps), 2) mid-term ops (batching + cache), 3) renewal conversation deck + cost forecast.
CostBot: Billing alert: account/altahealth reached 82% of monthly credits at 2026-03-08T04:12:01Z.
Sarah: Short-term: propose a soft token cap and email escalation at 90%. Can we auto-throttle nightly jobs to 30% of previous run?
TJ: We can add a token cap on their account config: `billing.token_cap = 120_000_000` and a webhook at 90% to the CS team. That should buy runway for the QBR.
Leo: For immediate savings, enable prefix/KV caching and suggest switching embedding model to quantized variant (`open-embed-2048-q8`) — ~3-4x cheaper per token for similar vectors. I'll prepare guidance.
Maria: Good. Also collect examples of hallucination/regression risk when moving to quantized embeddings for their dataset — we should be transparent.
TJ: I'll run a 7-day forecast from current run rate and include a conservative (x1.2) and aggressive (x1.6) scenario. Will post numbers here by EOD.
Sarah: I'll prep a renewal slide with the cost delta and recommended mitigations. Need an owner for the enablement walkthrough.
Leo: I'll own the walkthrough. Suggest 45-min session: 15m theory (batching + cache), 20m ops (how-to + scripts), 10m Q&A.
Maria: Assignments: TJ — forecast & alert config; Leo — enablement doc + demo; Sarah — renewal slide + risk statement; Maria — runbook + QBR agenda.
CostBot: Note: scheduled job 'alta-reindex' ran 03/07 02:00 UTC and consumed 18M tokens. Consider adding `--changed-since` filter.
TJ: I'll reach out to their engineer (cc Jules) to suggest adding `--changed-since` and a `--batch-size=500` flag. That alone should trim ~60% of that nightly cost.
Sarah: Can we offer a one-time credits buffer if they commit to a 6mo retainer? I want to include an option in the deck.
Maria: Yes — propose a 10% credits bonus on a 6mo commit. I'll coordinate with finance but include it as a conditional offer in the QBR.
Leo: Draft checklist for QBR enablement: 
```
- Current run rate + 7d forecast
- Alert and token cap config
- Embedding model alternatives (cost + quality tradeoffs)
- Reindexing best-practices (changed-since, dedupe, batch)
- Enablement slide + demo plan
- Renewal options (retainer tiers + credit bonus)
```
Maria: Perfect. TJ, can you paste the forecast numbers by 6pm PT?
TJ: Yep — will post here.
Sarah: I'll schedule QBR invite and the enablement session after we confirm the mitigations. Tentative: QBR Tue 10am PT, enablement Thu 11am PT.
Maria: Thanks all — prefer lightweight notes in this thread so we can snapshot for the meeting. 
Leo: Adding a small snippet for the ops doc: `curl -X POST /v1/admin/accounts/altahealth/config -d '{"billing": {"token_cap": 120000000}}'`
CostBot: Reminder: next billing cycle starts 2026-03-15.
Maria: Locking owners and next steps. TJ -> forecast, Leo -> enablement + model test, Sarah -> renewal slide, Maria -> runbook + offer. Follow-ups in this thread. :thumbsup:
